relaxed.description: Neutral resting hand; fingers gently curled. Default when hands aren't the focus.

flat_open.description: Open palm, fingers extended and together. Waves, stop, high-five, push.

five_spread.description: Open hand, all five fingers spread apart. Number five/ten, splayed displays.

fist.description: Fully closed fist. Solidarity, knock, resolve.

thumb_up.description: Closed fist with thumb extended upward. Thumbs up / approval.

ok_ring.description: Thumb and index tips touching in a ring, other three fingers extended. OK sign.

point_index.description: Index extended, remaining fingers curled into the palm. Pointing, number one, beckon.

two_v.description: Index and middle extended in a V, others curled. Number two, victory/peace.

three_fingers.description: Index, middle, ring extended; thumb holds pinky. Number three.

four_fingers.description: All four fingers extended, thumb folded across palm. Number four.

pinch.description: Thumb and index tips nearly touching, small gap. Money rub, small-size, precision.

crossed_fingers.description: Index and middle crossed. Luck / promise.

finger_gun.description: Index extended forward, thumb up, others curled. Finger gun / playful point.
